# ISAiL (Indo Secure AI Lab)

> ISAiL (Indo Secure AI Lab, also written Indo Secure AI Labs) is a multidisciplinary research and engineering initiative dedicated to advancing AI that is safe and trustworthy for India. Website: https://isailab.com. Contact: contact@isailab.com. Instagram: @isail_lab.

ISAiL is built on a simple belief: AI must be built safely, governed well and deployed responsibly. The lab brings together technologists, policy thinkers and domain specialists to research, build and deploy AI across three pillars:

1. Technical alignment and security: model safety evaluations, red-teaming, prompt security and safety alignment, including for Indic and regional languages.
2. Sovereign strategy and e-governance: technology policy, sovereign compute, data privacy, and how public institutions can use AI to serve citizens better.
3. Real-world deployment: scalable AI for public good in areas such as healthcare, agriculture and education, across 22+ regional languages.

ISAiL calls this approach techno-civic stewardship: treating AI not only as a technology, but as a responsibility. ISAiL also runs bootcamps and fellowships that bring curious students from every discipline into its work.

## Indo Youth AI Leadership Program 2026

ISAiL's current program for school students.

- What: a selective six-day AI leadership program. Students learn to think, create, decide and lead with AI, and every participant pitches at the Pitch Summit before a jury of experts and the chief guest. It is not a coding course; no prior knowledge of AI, coding, business or public speaking is needed.
- When: 26 to 31 December 2026, 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM daily.
- Where: IIIT Delhi (Indraprastha Institute of Information Technology Delhi), New Delhi.
- Who can apply: students in Grades 9 to 12, and students who completed Grade 12 in 2026, from any school, board or stream. Applicants must be Indian citizens and comfortable learning in English.
- Fee: ₹13,000, including the program, meals, program kit and access to campus facilities such as the gym, library and labs. Limited on-campus residence costs an additional ₹9,000, subject to availability.
- Scholarships: need-based financial aid of up to 75% of the program fee, subject to document verification and committee review. Scholarship applicants must apply by 20 November 2026.
- Selection: online application, shortlisting, Group Discussion, final selection.
- Key dates: applications open 27 October 2026; Group Discussions begin 1 November 2026; scholarship applicants apply by 20 November 2026; application deadline 30 November 2026; final selection 1 to 20 December 2026.
- What students learn (seven strands): Know Yourself as a Leader; Think with AI; Design for People; Create and Build with AI; Decide and Build an Enterprise; Lead with Integrity; Inspire and Persuade.
- Every participant receives a certificate of participation.
